shortDescription: According to Nikkei Asia, India’s drive to become a major hub for artificial intelligence is opening a large opportunity for the country’s renewable energy industry. Data center companies need huge amounts of electricity and are willing to sign long-term power contracts.

title: India’s AI Push Creates Opportunity For Renewable Energy Firms
